title: Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for Robust Planetary Landing
abstract: arXiv:2610.20252v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) policies for planetary landing and other aerospace guidance, navigation, and control tasks are commonly trained under randomized disturbances to improve robustness. However, typical stochastic perturbation sampling assumes independent variations, whereas real mission disturbances often exhibit spatial and temporal correlation and cannot be reproduced through independent random draws. This work investigates adversarial reinforcement learning to discover challenging off-nominal conditions. A secondary agent generates physically constrained perturbations that degrade the performance of a landing controller, forming an asymmetric sequential zero-sum game. Training proceeds in three stages: baseline controller learning, robustness enhancement with stochastic perturbations, and an iterative adversarial phase in which the controller and disturbance generator are alternately optimized. translated_title: 用于鲁棒行星着陆的对抗性强化学习
translated_abstract: 用于行星着陆以及其他航空航天制导、导航与控制任务的深度强化学习（DRL）策略，通常在随机化扰动下进行训练以提高鲁棒性。然而，典型的随机扰动采样假设各扰动变化相互独立，而实际任务中的扰动往往表现出空间与时间上的相关性，无法通过独立的随机抽样来复现。本工作研究对抗性强化学习，以发现具有挑战性的非标称条件。一个辅助智能体生成物理受限的扰动来降低着陆控制器的性能，从而形成非对称的序贯零和博弈。训练分为三个阶段进行：基线控制器学习、借助随机扰动进行鲁棒性增强，以及控制器与扰动生成器交替优化的迭代对抗阶段。在……中的初步实验（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种三阶段对抗性强化学习训练框架，由辅助智能体生成具有时空相关性且满足物理约束的最坏情况扰动，与着陆控制器形成非对称序贯零和博弈并交替优化，从而显著提升行星着陆策略应对非标称条件的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a three-stage adversarial reinforcement learning framework where an auxiliary agent generates physically constrained, spatiotemporally correlated worst-case perturbations against the landing controller in an asymmetric sequential zero-sum game, alternately optimizing both agents to enhance the robustness of planetary landing policies under off-nominal conditions.
